limits: Cubase reference runtime cases and candidate conformance cases remain zero; whole-product fidelity unestablished.
Application timing, curve, pan/balance and linear resampling policies are independently implemented. Static declarations do not establish native arithmetic.

DAWproject is a strict flat mono/stereo audio subset: no musical anchors, ramps, complex routing, plugins, MIDI or disabled automation; unsupported content rejects. Local roundtrip and XSD validity do not establish Cubase interoperability.
Ambisonic UI exercised one 9-channel float64 direction; automated file tests cover all 12 channel/precision/direction configurations. No live multichannel bus, VST lifecycle or hardware capture.
Tempo ramps, audio stretching, automation write modes, recording, MIDI editing, CPR objects, plugin hosting, PDC, complete routing and remaining DSP/UI are pending.
Prepared buffers rebuild and restart at current position on edits; not a continuous realtime mixer.
Native accessibility interactions and selected screenshot inspection are not an exhaustive mouse drag, keyboard or accessibility audit.
Output peaks observe AVAudioEngine buffers; no hardware DAC capture or listening claim. Source media and file size limits remain explicit.
GUI observations are analyst records of tool-returned state; screenshots were inspected in the conversation but not retained as separate image files.
